title: We booked a flamenco tour via pancho tours
text: Nice guy Rafa from pancho tours Who told a lot of the history of the flamenco. Thans a lot for this tour.
author: PeterEnMargotO

title: Intimate & entertaining
text: This was a really interesting and informative evening especially coming from Australia. Maria was entertaining in her explanation of the history of flamenco and the history of the area. The small venue Made the tour even more special with only 18 people in the audience. Definitely recommend this tour.
author: Helen M

title: A pleasant hour of traditional dancing
text: I was booked in for the show only so no tour: just turned up at the appointed time. The room was a small hall of sorts with chairs all laid out below the stage for the small audience of about 30 people. The show was fairly basic: just a guitarist, a singer and a male & and older female dancer. I enjoyed it: very intense dancing, stomping and clapping. I felt it was quite genuine and traditional, not a showy performance.  Lasted for 1 hour.
author: suzannewales55
